cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

mechanism: A turns leaving a social visit into a pupil etiquette assessment and claims sole right to pass the goodbye.
confusable: Not teaching manners incidentally: completion of the supposed lesson controls whether B may leave.
comparison: Workplace closing approval versus social departure practice.
seedUse: D50 coffee/bus/cafe closing; S05 etiquette lesson substitutes for generic authority.
